items.notes: Lemma 4.4 (tensor commutant: commutant of End(V) tensor 1 is 1 tensor End(W)). Block-matrix proof matches source Eq.(4.2)-(4.3) exactly. Finite-dim complex V,W stated. Uses center(End V)=scalars, justified in-proof via rank-one ops/irreducibility, no unstated hypothesis. Distinct from representation-batch plan-105 (EndG scalar of ONE irrep): this is the tensor-factor commutant. New core.

Prop 4.5(i)-(iii) + Exercise 4.2 bicommutant step. Pairwise-INEQUIVALENT irreducibles with multiplicity n_alpha correctly assumed (so A' has no cross-type blocks); isotypical projections in A force block-diagonality. Uses 301 as sub-lemma (within-batch), A''=A by second application. Correct.

External product (phi tensor psi)(g,h)=phi(g) tensor psi(h) vs diagonal phi(g) tensor phi(g): contrast correct. Irreducibility via character-norm factorization, exhaustion via conjugacy-class counting #irr(GxH)=#cls(G)*#cls(H), valid for FINITE groups per assumptions. Minor anchor nit: Exercise 4.1 is on PDF p43 (Sec 4.4), not p38; Def 4.2 + the two facts are p38. Math unaffected. New core.

Schur-Weyl mutual commutant: B=span{U^{tn}} equals A'=span{X^{tn}}, B'=A. The 'A'=span X^{tn} known' hypothesis is exactly Cor 4.8, explicitly flagged as given (not smuggled). Lagrange interpolation correctly extends invertible X+t1 to non-invertible X at t=0 (degree-n poly, n+1 points). Domain correct: GL(V) diagonal; NO spurious d>=n restriction. Double commutant for final step. Absent from rep batch and first-50. New core.

Cor 4.8: conjugation-invariant C in span{X^{tn}}. Identifies End(V^{tn})~End(V)^{tn}, conjugation by permutation = factor action on End(V)^{tn}, invariance => symmetric subspace, applies spanning lemma (306/Lemma 4.7) with underlying space End(V). Faithful. New core.

Lemma 4.7: Sym^n(V)=span{v^{tn}}. Reverse inclusion via polarization (symmetrized basis tensors as mixed partials Eq.4.11-4.14), limits of difference quotients of single-vector powers, closedness of finite-dim span W. Finite-dim stated. Matches source. New core.

Young diagram p>d rows contributes nothing: filled tableau from d-letter alphabet, first column length p>d, pigeonhole => repeated label, column antisymmetrization (c_T factor of e_T=r_T c_T) kills it. Mechanism correctly identified. Faithful to p48 remark. New core.

Antisymmetrizer P_a vanishes if d<n: image=totally antisymmetric subspace spanned by wedges; repeated index => vanishing wedge; n>d pigeonhole; rank=C(d,n)=0. Matches Exercise 5.2. Distinct from 307 (signed average projector vs Young symmetrizer; n>d vs row-count), not a repeated count.

Majorization annihilation Eq.(5.25): e_T kills v iff sorted content NOT majorized by lambda, i.e. some 1<=k<=d-1 with sum of k largest contents > sum of first k rows. k-range matches source. Column-strict-filling-feasibility justification is a correct gloss. Generalizes 307 but a distinct quantitative criterion. New core.

(C^3)^{t4} recomputed independently: partitions of 4 into <=3 parts (4),(3,1),(2,2),(2,1,1); d_lambda=1,3,2,3; m_{lambda,3}=15,15,6,3 [(4):C(6,2)=15; (3,1):3*5/2*2=15; (2,2):1*2*3=6; (2,1,1):2*3/2*1=3]; products 15,45,12,9 sum 81=3^4. All correct, matches Exercise 5.3(iii)/Eq.5.29. New core.

dim U^2_lambda=lambda_1-lambda_2+1 two ways: (a) two-letter SSYT (columns forced 1-over-2, lambda_1-lambda_2 free first-row cells => +1); (b) det^{lambda_2} tensor Sym^m(C^2), m=lambda_1-lambda_2, det 1-dim, Sym^m dim m+1. Agree. Matches Eq.5.26. New core.

Hook formula (4,2,1): hooks 6,4,2,1/3,1/1, product 144, 7!=5040, 5040/144=35. Matches Example 5.11. Single-row and single-column of n: hook product n! each, count 1. Correct. New core (concrete computation, distinct from 310's sum identity).

Conjugate of cycle by sigma = cycle on sigma-images (Eq.5.4/5.37); both directions of cycle-type conjugacy (forward: disjoint-cycle length preservation; converse: explicit sigma matching equal-length cycles entrywise, well-defined as cycles partition ground set). Complete. New core.

OVERCLAIM. native_nl.new_problem_core=true, existing_core_aliases=[] but the core -- F involution (F^2=1), eigenvalues +-1, (1+-F)/2 complementary orthogonal projectors onto sym/antisym subspaces of a tensor square -- IS the core of representation-batch plan-112 (sym-antisym-projectors-swap-operator), proved there identically. Only increment is dim Sym=d(d+1)/2, dim Lambda=d(d-1)/2 (just source Eq.6.9/6.11), insufficient for a new core. Math CORRECT and faithful to p52-53; reject is purely for the unasked novelty overclaim, not a math error. Shared-lemma collision found by content comparison, not ID.

U-tensor-U Haar twirl: yields Werner state (left-invariance), idempotent (Werner states are fixed points), preserves visibility alpha=tr(F rho) (cyclicity + (UtU)^dag F (UtU)=F). Matches Prop 6.3(i)(ii). Distinct from Pauli-twirl plan-107: there commutant is scalar (irreducible=>Schur, single point); here commutant is 2-dim (sym (+) antisym), twirl lands on 1-param Werner family. Not the same twirling core. New core.

OVERCLAIM. new_problem_core=true, aliases=[] but the core -- Werner state entangled iff tr(F rho)<0, via F^{T_B}=d|Phi+><Phi+| giving a negative PT eigenvalue plus twirled-product separability for alpha>=0 -- is first-50 core plan-007 (werner-entanglement-threshold), same iff and method (two-qubit, PT eigenvalue x/2, swap-trick). This generalizes to general d (lambda_1=alpha(d^2-1), Eq.6.37-6.38) but the core result/proof is the same; d=2 is the special case. Math CORRECT; reject for novelty overclaim (should be existing_view aliasing plan-007).

Multipartite Werner (U^{tn}-invariant) states = linear combinations of factor-permutation operators. Faithful to Eq.6.39-6.40. But core content is the Schur-Weyl mutual-commutant A'=B (span of permutations) applied -- i.e. plan-304 re-used. core_verdict existing_view (alias plan-304) to avoid double-counting the mutual-commutant core; the problem framing is a legitimate distinct question so the item is accepted, only core-novelty downgraded. Not an external overclaim (its own new_problem_core/aliases are internally consistent in spirit).

Permutation-invariant operator = poly(n) parameters for fixed d: Schur-Weyl blocks (<=d-row diagrams), invariance => identity on each S_n factor, free on each U_d factor; count = sum over diagrams of (dim U^d_lambda)^2; bounded by #diagrams<=(n+1)^d (Eq.5.31) times dim U^d_lambda<=(n+1)^{d(d-1)/2} (Eq.5.33) => polynomial. Matches Cor 5.19. New core.

Spectrum concentration: rho^{tn} block-diagonal; block weight = dim V_lambda * tr omega_lambda(rho); two-sided bound ~ exp(-n D(lambda-bar||s)) up to poly(n) prefactors (Eq.5.36). D>=0, =0 only at lambda-bar=s => mass concentrates near spectrum; poly prefactors cannot beat the exponential. Rate correctly D(lambda-bar||s). Matches Eq.5.35-5.36. New core.

rho isotropic (invariant under U-tensor-conj(U)) iff rho^{T_B} Werner. Uses PT sandwich identity Eq.6.46 and (conj U)^T=U^dag, transporting U-tensor-conj(U) symmetry into U-tensor-U (Werner); PT involution gives both directions. Matches Def 6.7/Eq.6.45-6.46. New core.
